# conative_azuresql_database_user (Resource)

Manages a contained database user for a Microsoft Entra application, user or group, created from its ID without a directory lookup.

Creating the resource fails if a principal with the same name already exists in the database; import it instead. Destroying it drops the user and fails, rather than forcing, if the database refuses (for example because the user owns a schema or other objects).

The database cannot tell an application from a user, so `type` is kept from configuration and is not read back. After an import, the first apply records `type` without replacing the user, provided the database reports a matching principal type (`EXTERNAL_USER` for `application` and `user`, `EXTERNAL_GROUP` for `group`); otherwise the user is replaced.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# An Entra application (a service principal or a managed identity), by its
# application (client) ID.
resource "conative_azuresql_database_user" "orders_app" {
  database = "orders"
  name     = "orders-app"
  type     = "application"
  entra_id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
}

# An Entra group, by its object ID.
resource "conative_azuresql_database_user" "operators" {
  database = "orders"
  name     = "orders-operators"
  type     = "group"
  entra_id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `database` (String) Database name. Changing it replaces the user.
- `entra_id` (String) For `application`, the application (client) ID. For `user` and `group`, the object ID. A GUID. Changing it replaces the user.
- `name` (String) User name in the database. Any name; it does not need to match the display name in Microsoft Entra ID. Changing it replaces the user.
- `type` (String) `application` (service principal or managed identity), `user` or `group`. Changing it replaces the user.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The import ID, `database/name`.
- `principal_type` (String) The principal type as reported by the database, for example `EXTERNAL_USER` or `EXTERNAL_GROUP`.
- `sid` (String) The user's security identifier as reported by the database, as `0x` followed by hexadecimal digits.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The import ID is database/name.
terraform import conative_azuresql_database_user.orders_app orders/orders-app
```
